result: Shanghai Port lost 0-1 to Shandong Taishan after 90 minutes. Shanghai Port -0.5 lost in full.
settlementBasis: Shanghai Port had to win the match after 90 minutes plus regulation stoppage time. A draw or Shandong Taishan win loses the wager.

review.resultAssessment: Shanghai Port failed to score in the second half and lost 0-1, so the -0.5 handicap lost in full for 250,000 VND (-0.25u).
review.processAssessment: The comeback thesis did not convert despite a missed penalty and a disallowed Shanghai Port goal in the second half. Those events show genuine attacking opportunity, but the wager still required a full match win from a 0-1 halftime deficit and carried substantial conversion and time-decay risk.
review.calibrationAction: For halftime favorite-comeback sides, require stronger evidence of repeatable high-quality chance creation rather than relying mainly on territorial pressure or isolated major events. Keep the 0.25u cap and 1.70 football minimum unchanged.
